profile.headline: Lead UI Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Experienced engineering manager with 8+ years of experience leading engineering teams and engineers across different streams and across multiple geographies. Some highlights include:  
At StubHub, I led the first modernization project of upgrading our UI stack to React and creating new micro services and hosting it in the cloud which resulted in reduced latency by 100% and fast shipping to customers by 300%.
I have built teams from scratch. I have mentored College students on their Internship program. Hired engineers for multiple teams.

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Lead Discover and Content team.
Led the modernization effort and accomplished cloud migration.  This helps the engineering team to develop and release code faster and helps the product to get the features on time.  
Create & manage our own CI/CD pipelines for deployment & traffic management.
Partnered with PMs and UX designers to not only deliver the new simplified product features but also revamped to a new tech stack on React which increased the page performance by 3 times compared to the previous stack. I have contributed on creating reusable React components.
Manages the engineering team with efficient staffing, team member development and training, performance management.
User Experience Test based development running A/B testing using Adobe Target and Optimizely. Owner for running Optimizely A/B test and collect data using omniture tracking tags and use data for reporting. Have regular monitoring on the dashboards and metrics to facilitate a data-driven approach.
Implemented SEO best practice for improving the page ranking.
Integrated Drupal 8.0 CMS system for first time which is used for merchandising.
Collaborate with Product Management in defining the product vision and guiding teams on planning, designing and building software.

positions.title: Member Of Technical Staff
positions.description:
Led global engineering team for domain launch. StubHub is now live in 20 domains.
Led Home, Browse & Search Team - redesigned Home, browse and search pages optimized the bundling process and improved the performance of the pages and reduced the loading time to 50%.
User Experience Test based development running A/B testing using Adobe Target and Optimizely which helped the organization to take quick decisions based on the data.
Lead Engineer – Code and manage GTM (Google Tag Manager) for marketing team. Consolidated all the tags in GTM for better efficiency and governance with a process for updates. 
Developed reusable components which was used by other pages and applications.

positions.title: Technology Specialist
positions.description:
Lead developer handled the domain launch from .com & international domains
Led the email migration system from legacy to StrongView which helped the organization to consolidate diff email system into one email system.
Developed new promotional and content pages for marketing team which helped the marketing team to do promotional campaigns which is a key part for company's revenue.
Lead developer working onsite and worked with offshore team located in India & China.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led 20-member team drove the planning and executing on rebranding Intel websites and developed developer services portal. 
Led the team of UI Engineers and content developers.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Next Generation Information platform is Intel’s architecture that will provide single integrated information delivery environment for entire Intel customers.
Redesigned Channel reseller website, ISN

honors.title: Spot Award
honors.description: Successfully completed the UI tech stack migration from backbone.js stack to react stack in 4 months.

honors.title: Spot Award
honors.description: Best Engineering support & technical advise for integrating the Oracle Chat in  Stubhub websites.
